messages.text:
"You are a senior Game AI Developer. I would like you to design an AI architecture for a \"living world\"—modeled after the logic found in *Red Dead Redemption 2* (RDR2)—and establish the foundational code and behavioral structures. Please provide a step-by-step guide and actionable code/logic examples (in C++, C#, or pseudocode) for the following three core systems: 1. DAILY ROUTINES AND MEMORY SYSTEM (NPC Living World @COMMENT_BODY@ Memory): - A State Machine or Behavior Tree structure that allows NPCs to transition between states based on a time-of-day cycle (e.g., Morning: Work; Evening: Tavern; Night: Home). - A \"Faction/Memory System\" (Reputation/Karma) that tracks the player’s past actions—whether criminal offenses or virtuous deeds. 2. ADVANCED TACTICAL COMBAT AND COVER SYSTEM (Combat AI): - A \"Cover Point System\" that enables enemies to locate the nearest safe cover. - Logic for flanking the player, as well as a \"Morale System\" that triggers retreat or surrender when enemy numbers dwindle. 3. HORSE AND ANIMAL AI (Animal @COMMENT_BODY@ Horse AI): - A mechanism for horses to react or become startled based on their \"bonding\" level with the player. - A \"Perception System\" for wild animals, allowing them to detect the player based on factors like distance and wind direction. As you provide your response, explain how these systems communicate with one another, and outline the essential data structures and functions required to implement them within a game engine (such as Unreal Engine or Unity). (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
